## 17:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him. |
| LOGOS | The LORD spoke concerning the sin engraved upon Judah's heart and the blessedness of trusting in Him. |
| PNEUMA | The LORD continued speaking about the deep-rooted sin of Judah and the blessing of trusting in God alone. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
